gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic keeps its lowercase rising close to the capitals, with curvy, unclamped letters. Irish Grover is the sturdier talker, big and slightly wobbly, while Noto Sans Mandaic does the quiet, tidy job of carrying the words.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Playful and organic, Irish Grover stacks up tall, sturdy lowercase with softly varied strokes, set against small, proud, almost capital-sized letters. Its heft is the show; Noto Sans Marchen is the clear-curved counterweight.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nume: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c, giving it a contemporary, businesslike look. Irish Grover next to it feels rounder and friendlier, its gentle weight gradient softening everything the Mayan Numerals font keeps crisp.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-medefaidri: Tall, friendly and a bit wobbly, Irish Grover has sturdy lowercase and strokes that barely vary in heft, over lettering that rises just as high. Noto Sans Medefaidrin keeps curves free of ink pools, so text moves along smoothly.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-meetei-may: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, a modern, open look. Irish Grover adds sturdy, tall words and a soft step from heavy to light, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-mende-kika: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve and stands tall. Irish Grover brings fun, organic heft with a small, steady stroke difference, and beside the body font's modern tidiness it feels like a cheerful shout over a clear voice.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic is approachable, with openings you can see through and lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Irish Grover supplies the modest weight shifts and sturdy tall letters, and a long page would settle in easily.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve and keeps its lowercase close to capital height, a clean, modern look. Irish Grover's tall, sturdy words and modest stroke modulation add fun and an organic feel to the page.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so none bump, with wide openings in every curve and tall lowercase. And Irish Grover, with hairline thinning at its curves, would feel cramped if made small, while the mono body stays easy at large sizes.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-mro: Fun and organic, Irish Grover has tall, sturdy lowercase and the mild thick-thin of a letterpress slug. Its best quality is the way that heft sits beside Noto Sans Mro, whose dense, tall words have large entrances into each letter.
